last_response.name: Sharp parry flash:
last_response.message: A one-shot parry flash of about 0.33 s (8 frames at 24 fps): a white-cyan star bursts from the centre, a thick crescent arc sweeps past with a dark ink edge, and cyan sparks fly out and fade. Try the Star colour, Arc colour and Sparks colour sliders, and the Arc thickness slider for a bolder crescent. Two things fall short of your brief: the star's ring and streaks still come out orange (from the part's own colours), and the black crescent reads as a thin dark edge rather than a solid black ink shape. Ask me to strip the orange or make the arc solid black and I'll do it.
